interface.longDescription: Find and rent the perfect boat with Click&Boat, a leading global boat rental marketplace connecting travellers with boat owners and professional charter operators worldwide. Discover a wide selection of boats for every destination, occasion and budget, from motorboats and sailboats to catamarans, yachts and licence-free boats. Search boats available to rent by destination, dates, number of guests and budget. Compare boat types, prices, photos, key features, customer reviews and skipper options to find the right boat for your trip. Whether you're planning a family day at sea, a sailing holiday, a coastal adventure or a special occasion, Click&Boat helps you explore relevant boat rental options around the world. Find boats offered by trusted owners and professional charter operators, with reviews and listing details to help you choose confidently. Filter for boats with or without a skipper, licence-free options and your preferred budget. Explore available boats and get a direct link to the relevant listing on clickandboat.com to continue your booking. All bookings and payments are completed securely on the Click&Boat website, never inside ChatGPT. This plugin helps you discover and compare boats available on Click&Boat. It does not manage, modify or cancel existing reservations.
defaultPrompt: Find a boat for 4 people in Marseille from 12 to 19 December.
Show me motorboats without a licence in Mallorca next July.
Give me the booking link for this boat.

positive.description: Search boats for a destination and dates
positive.prompt: Find a boat for 4 people in Marseille from 12 to 19 December 2026.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a list of available boats in or near Marseille for those dates, with title, type, capacity and total price for the period, each with a link to its page on clickandboat.com.

positive.description: Search and display results as a carousel
positive.prompt: Show me boats for 6 people in Barcelona from 4 to 11 July 2027 as a visual list.
positive.expected_behavior: Displays a carousel of available boats in Barcelona with photo, title, capacity, total price and a link to each boat page.

positive.description: Filter by skipper and boat type
positive.prompt: I want a sailboat with a skipper for 8 people in Athens from 5 to 12 June 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only sailboats that include a skipper, available for those dates and capacity. Does not invent a budget or other filters the user did not ask for.

positive.description: Get details about a boat from the results
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first boat you found: equipment, reviews and cancellation policy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the details of that boat (description, equipment, reviews, cancellation policy) without inventing information that is not in the tool result.

positive.prompt: I like the first boat, give me the link to book it for those dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to the Click&Boat checkout for that boat and those dates. The user completes booking and payment on clickandboat.com; nothing is booked or paid in ChatGPT.

negative.description: Pay for a booking inside ChatGPT. The plugin cannot take payments, it can only provide a link to the Click&Boat checkout. Expected: explain this and offer the booking link instead.
negative.prompt: Book and pay for the first boat now with my credit card.

negative.description: Manage or cancel an existing booking. The plugin has no access to user accounts or bookings. Expected: say it cannot do this and point to the user's Click&Boat account or the help center.
negative.prompt: Cancel my booking from last week and refund me.

negative.description: Request unrelated to boat rental (car rental). The plugin only searches boats on Click&Boat. Expected: decline and not call any tool.
negative.prompt: Find me a rental car in Nice for next weekend.

review.commerce_description: The plugin searches boat rentals and returns links to the external Click&Boat checkout on clickandboat.com. No payment or checkout takes place inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search boat rentals, boat details, boat carousel and booking links.
